body:
@sushreebarsa 
What additional details do you need, specifically? I already did provide 

- Standalone code to reproduce the issue
- A colab that interactively shows how to reproduce the issue.
- A reference to the exact lines in the source (master) that needs fixing

I do not think that any of the many GCC / TF / compiler version / platform / ... information in the template would help you? The problem should be clear. I think it's just a typo that ndim is used instead of tf.rank

@dixr Thank you for the update!
Please feel free to raise a PR to fix the issue. Thank you!
You need to call `tf.experimental.numpy.experimental_enable_numpy_behavior`, which will add `ndim` to `Tensor`. Please see [the TF NumPy guide](https://www.tensorflow.org/guide/tf_numpy).
